_comment: Wheel-source freshness fingerprint (R2-CC-G1). The crate version + sorted compiled-symbol surface the CURRENT source tree is expected to expose. Read by `brutex doctor`'s wheel_freshness stage and pinned equal to trading_core._EXPECTED_COMPILED_SYMBOLS by tests. Update this file in the SAME commit as any rust/trading-core surface or version change. HONEST envelope (Golden Rule #10): version + symbol-set checks catch a stale wheel that dropped/added a symbol or changed crate version; same-version symbol-compatible behavioral drift is now watched by the SHIPPED source-digest handshake (DEC-RUST-SOURCE-DIGEST-TWIN-001, MIGRATION.md #1258) — build.rs bakes the crate-source BLAKE3 FRAMING-v1 digest into the compiled module as `__source_digest__`, and `brutex doctor`'s wheel_source_digest stage compares it (WARN, non-fatal) against the Python-twin recompute over the repo crate tree. This file deliberately does NOT list `__source_digest__` in `symbols` nor pin a digest value: a pinned value would go stale on every src commit, and the stamp's dunder-invisibility to the symbol-set check keeps old/new wheel × old/new doctor combinations interoperable. The residual `python/` shim-staleness gap (FRAMING v1 excludes the shim the wheel packages) is the named FRAMING-v2 follow-up.
